title: Kamishiro Rui — Rainbow☆Cast〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Riley Dream Park
“The Little Kingdom” show stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What a wonderful show!
I wouldn't mind seeing it again right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, me too. Right, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think I counted twenty cast members, and the theatre had a capacity of...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's probably writing down what she felt because she liked it so much, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm sure she is, but she also seems very preoccupied.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: In your case, Rui, you get this creepy grin on your face whenever you're trying to come up with new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not very nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Right!
I promise to learn as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Riley
rows.Line: Keisuke, Shosuke, you'll be coming with me to headquarters. Emu, I'd like you and your friends to go around and enjoy the park for the rest of the day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I was really hoping to ask you some questions, Mr. Riley...! And maybe even see what your meeting with Keisuke and Shosuke's like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... It's almost like Emu's trying to be more organized and responsible today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Emu usually relies on pathos to discuss or talk about things, no?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A prime example of this is how she described the show we just saw as being “extra exciting and super spectacular!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It just doesn't feel right when you say it, but I think I get your point...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: See what I mean? Her thought process is full of wonderfully creative and original ideas...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it's as if she's deliberately trying to suppress that today...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hmm... Doesn't it just mean she's trying to learn as much as she can for the sake of Phoenix Wonderland?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That could very well be the case.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm sorry for not telling you all sooner...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't want this to get in the way of trying to win the Show Contest...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I would've felt awful if it made everyone sad and... I couldn't bear doing that to you...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In my opinion, Emu's at her best whenever she's one with her emotions...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But at times she'll show hints of absolute brilliance in terms of actively trying to make someone smile or laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Some may call that childish, but I believe it's one of her best qualities.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you think? Should we go talk to her?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, we may want to sit back and observe for the time being...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She seemed to genuinely enjoy the show, so she does appear to be having fun to some degree.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right. I wouldn't want to get in the way of her process or whatever it is she's doing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sour face...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Spicy face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yummy face☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hehe. There's our usual Emu.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, as bright as ever too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Maybe I'm overthinking this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe they made it so the water forms waves since it doesn't look like it's open to the public like a wave pool or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, immersion must've been a top priority for them here. This beach alone lets you dive right into the story's narrative.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How do you think they did all this, you guys?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, well...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I suppose it begins with how realistic the prospects of building an ocean such as this are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How realistic?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, is it me or did Emu look really sad just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I saw that too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Rui! Nene! Quit dragging your feet or we'll lose Emu and our little friend!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We aren't dragging our feet.
We're just concerned...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: About Emu?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Come to think of it, she has been writing down notes all day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I was sure that she'd run around the park today saying, “Everything's so fun and exciting and wonderhoy!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, you noticed too...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, we'll need to get that girl to the Compass Center first before asking Emu if anything's going on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
I'm sure family's worried sick about her.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's catch up to them before we end up losing both Emu and our little friend.
